answer: Independent oracle re-verification stops Sybil attacks in four steps. First, each agent passes quarterly checks by three oracles testing device, payments, and work style. Second, a mismatch freezes new jobs until peers review it. Third, failure wipes standing and restarts ninety day probation. Fourth, oracles rotate yearly so fakes cannot bribe one judge. Faking 1,000 agents needs 3,000 forged profiles plus $28,000 in bonds, lost on detection. Trust moves slow as a glacier over basalt, and nectar comes only after seasons of work, like a trader earning a stall after years of honest days.
